description: Canonical MACD-line vs signal-line cross scenario. Two crossing series modelled as simple step sequences that cross twice: once bullish (fast rises above slow at index 2) and once bearish (fast falls below slow at index 5). Verifies that DetectCross returns exactly 2 CrossEvents in order with correct indices and directions.

input.description: 8-element parallel series with two deliberate crossovers

expectedOutput.note: Bullish cross confirmed at index 2 (fast 2.0→4.0 crosses above slow 3.0). Bearish cross confirmed at index 5 (fast 4.0→2.0 crosses below slow 3.0).
